title: HomelabNext service registry (services.yml)
description: Single source of truth for what runs where. Every endpoint, scrape target, proxy site, firewall rule, DNS record and environment file is generated from this document. Schema version 1; evolve additively. 2.0 closes every free-text field that generators interpolate: owners and identifiers are slugs, paths are URL path characters, descriptions are single lines, and every pattern rejects a trailing newline (Python re lets $ match before one; ECMA-262 does not). 2.1 adds status_sources: what the status hub may poll or receive for a service, by registry name only (docs/status.md, ADR-0013). 2.2 adds the agent-activity status-source kind with its built-in mappers, and front_door: the shared-secret header the edge adds in front of a service that trusts its forward-auth identity headers (the status hub's private tier). 2.3 adds the product status kinds (poll-uptime-kuma, poll-stackstorm, poll-nifi; poll-prometheus is no longer reserved), a source's auth (a credential by secret-store name) and the product mapping keys (query, thresholds, empty, window_s, limit) with the built-ins prometheus-alerts, orchestrator-queue and agentmetry-audit. 2.4 adds a service's one-line description, shown by the generated maps (ADR-0018). 2.5 adds the poll-nut status kind (a UPS read from Network UPS Tools' upsd over its TCP protocol), auth.username (the NUT USERNAME; the secret is its PASSWORD) and the poll-nut mapping keys (ups, tls, allow_plaintext, ca_file, limits). 2.6 adds the job-last-run built-in mapper (poll-file): the last-run records role timers write on each host, one item per job and host (docs/status.md).

owner.description: Owning team as a slug, e.g. platform-team.

capability.description: The stable alias consumers resolve: <capability>.<svc_label>.<domain>. Swapping the product behind it never changes consumers.

upstreams.description: Capability aliases this service calls. Drives env wiring and the firewall matrix.

clients.description: Extra zones (beyond dependants) allowed to reach this service.

owner.description: Owning team as a slug, e.g. data-team; interpolated into proxy, IdP and docs output.

description.description: (2.4) What the service does, in one line (the topology and dataflow maps show it). Informational only; no generator interpolates it.

env_var.description: Override of the default endpoint env var name.

scope.description: Writer-tool scope (homelabnext.scope). 'out' keeps tools from filing tasks, notes or findings about this service; absent = inherit from its host guest, else in.

status_sources.description: Status sources this service offers the status hub (the menu: hnx status sources, docs/status/sources.md). Targets are registry names, never addresses.

front_door.description: The service trusts the forward-auth identity headers only on requests that carry this header with the shared secret, which the edge adds (Caddy header_up from the environment variable named after the secret reference). Needs auth: idp and a public_hostname.

secret.description: A name in the secret store; the value is never in the registry.

id.description: Unique across the registry; the graph node is status:<id>.

kind.description: agent-activity (2.2) drains agent activity into the hub's activity store and reports stuck and errored sessions. The product kinds (2.3; poll-prometheus was reserved before) read a product's own API: a Prometheus instant query or its alerts, an Uptime Kuma public status page, StackStorm executions, NiFi controller status and bulletins (docs/status.md). poll-nut (2.5) reads UPSes from a NUT upsd (a tcp service) with LIST VAR; the hub also generates one per site power.ups entry monitored by nut.

auth.description: 2.3: the credential an HTTP kind sends, by secret-store name (the value is never in the registry): the header named here, else Authorization: Bearer. A reference that does not resolve is that source's error; it is never polled without it.

header.description: e.g. St2-Api-Key or X-API-Key; absent = Authorization: Bearer <value>.

username.description: 2.5, poll-nut only: the NUT USERNAME (upsd.users); the secret is its PASSWORD.

service.description: Registry service to poll (default: the declaring service), resolved through its capability alias.

path.description: URL path (and query) on the target service.

file.description: poll-file: a file or directory relative to the status root (a checkout or the hub's data directory).

stale_after_s.description: Default 3 x interval_s; must be >= interval_s.

on_error.description: What a failed poll means: unknown (the items age into stale) or fail (the source is a liveness probe).

what.description: One line: what this source reports.

status_mapping.description: Payload -> status observations: a named built-in mapper, or declarative selectors (homelabnext.status.mapping).

builtin.description: job-last-run (2.6, poll-file): a directory of last-run records (schemas/status/last_run.schema.json), one item <job id>@<host> each.

query.description: poll-prometheus: the PromQL instant query (an instant vector or a scalar).

thresholds.description: poll-prometheus (each sample) and poll-nifi (queued flowfiles): a value at or above (direction below: at or below) fail is fail, else at or past warn is warn, else ok.

empty.description: poll-prometheus: an empty result is one item in this state (absent: no items).

window_s.description: poll-stackstorm: how far back failed executions count (default 3600).

limit.description: poll-stackstorm: executions per poll; poll-nifi: bulletins per poll (default 100).

warn_after_s.description: records-lanes, broker-pending: an oldest item older than this is warn. job-last-run: a run whose calendar cannot be read exactly is late this long after its start.

items.description: The list (or mapping) of items; absent = the payload is one item.

item.description: An item's name, relative to the item (@key = its key in a mapping).

state.description: The raw state, relative to the item.

states.description: Raw state (as lower-cased text) -> state; an unmapped raw value is unknown.

summary.description: A one-line summary, relative to the item.

ups.description: 2.5, poll-nut: the NUT upsname to read; absent = every UPS upsd lists, and the template the hub expands into one source per site UPS monitored by nut.

tls.description: 2.5, poll-nut: STARTTLS with a verified certificate (default), or none.

allow_plaintext.description: 2.5, poll-nut: with tls none, send the NUT password to a non-loopback upsd anyway.

ca_file.description: 2.5, poll-nut: the CA bundle upsd's certificate is verified with, relative to the status root (default: the system's).

limits.description: 2.5, poll-nut: battery charge (%) and runtime (s) are judged at or below, load (%) at or above (defaults charge 50/20 or the UPS's battery.charge.low, runtime 600/120 or battery.runtime.low, load 80/95).
